cr_data.provenance: (Alfred Stieglitz, New York, NY); Dr. Leo Stieglitz, New York, NY, 1920s; Descended in family; (Doris Bry, New York, NY); (Joan T. Washburn, New York, NY) (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Ptd. about 1923." Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Sold to Dr. Leo Stieglitz." O'Keeffe visited York Beach, Maine, which served as inspiration for this piece, several times in the 1920s. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 13. See cat. nos. 382–87. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Blue Sea with Rocks

description: Pastel. Rocky pieces of land extend into a bright blue sea. The larger landform extends from the right edge of the composition to its center. On the left, two bits of land are visible. The ocean is calm, and no waves are visible.
title: Blue Sea with Rocks
